data.gender_notes: Isamel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ἰσάμελ (Isamel), which is a combination of two elements: isos (equal) and helios (sun). In Greek mythology, Helios is the god of the sun. The name Isamel thus means 'equal to the sun god'. In a Christian context, it can be interpreted as 'God of El' or 'Equal to God'. The name Isamel carries the meaning “God of El” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Isamel usually hope their child will grow to embody god of el and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.meaning: God's power, strength of God, power of God
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from Hebrew 'izzim' (strength, power) and 'El' (God), Isamel signifies the power, strength, or might of God. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes spiritual empowerment, courage, and resilience. As a given name, Isamel is often associated with biblical figures, such as the sons of Jacob (Genesis 30:8-10, 30:11-13) and is also linked to the concept of divine authority. In modern times, Isamel is used across Christian cultures to represent a strong connection with God's power and presence.
